notes: The expanded complementary sidebar (#sidebar, role=complementary) already exposes buttons named Notes, Archive, Trash and 'Edit Labels' (case-insensitively matches 'Edit labels'), plus a Reminders label button. REQ-6.1 requires the expanded sidebar to show unique buttons named Notes, Reminders, Edit labels, Archive, Trash; the existing Reminders label button satisfies that check. Changes: (1) rename the header toggle button accessible name from 'Main menu' to 'Toggle sidebar' and maintain aria-expanded on it, because helpers.openSidebar expands the sidebar by clicking /^Toggle sidebar$/i and REQ-6.2 checks its aria-expanded; (2) give #sidebar role='complementary' (used by helpers.openSidebar/clickSidebarLabel/openTrash/openArchive). A separate top-level 'Reminders' nav button is intentionally NOT added because clickSidebarLabel('Reminders') (REQ-2.7.6.3) resolves within complementary with a strict single-match query and a duplicate would break it. Depends on REQ-1.1 (home page already implemented).
